description: Main entry point and core routing logic for a Flutter app that loads and displays local HTML assets. Defines the main widget, route management, index and error screens, and a widget for rendering HTML assets with relative URL adjustments.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application defining the route logic.

classes.name: ScreensIndex
classes.description: Screen displaying a list of all generated screens with navigation links.

classes.name: HtmlAssetScreen
classes.description: Screen wrapper that displays a local HTML asset within a scaffold.

classes.name: HtmlAssetWebView
classes.description: Stateful widget that loads and injects base href into HTML assets for proper relative URL handling.

classes.name: _HtmlAssetWebViewState
classes.description: State class managing loading, injecting, and rendering HTML content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: App entry point. Ensures widget binding is initialized and runs the application.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method in various widgets defining their UI structure.

methods.name: _loadHtml
methods.description: Asynchronously loads HTML from assets, injects base href, and updates state.

methods.name: _injectBaseHref
methods.description: Inserts a <base href> tag and rewrites relative paths in HTML content to absolute paths within assets.
